warranty_start_conditions.notes: Coverage begins on the invoice/purchase date shown on purchase_proof. If requires_product_registration is true, the customer must register within registration_grace_days of purchase or standard coverage still applies but claims may be routed to manual_review for verification.

excluded_scenarios: unauthorized repair performed before claim submission
tampered or removed serial number / IMEI
screen damage from drop without extended (accidental damage) protection

claim_reporting_period.description: Claim must be submitted within 30 days of the fault occurrence date.

grace_periods.late_reporting_grace_description: Claims filed 30-37 days after fault occurrence are not hard-failed; they are downgraded to manual_review instead of auto-reject.
grace_periods.near_expiry_grace_description: If the fault occurred before warranty expiry but the claim is filed up to 15 days after the nominal expiry date, warranty_status is treated as 'Near Expiry' (manual review) rather than 'Expired' (hard fail).

eligible_if_any: fault_type is in irreparable_fault_types for this category
repair cost estimate exceeds replacement_cost_threshold_percent of purchase price

warning_rules: previous_repair_count > 0 (note repair history on the claim, does not block)
extended_warranty == 'Yes' used to cover an otherwise-excluded damage cause (flag for audit trail)
claim amount is within 10% of max_claim_amount for the category
claim filed within late_reporting_grace_days of the reporting deadline
repair_center is authorized but outside the customer's home region
